mission: GST Stage 1 critical engineering blocker follow-up

purchase_application_rls.observed: Purchase application evidence remains bootstrap-role evidence.
purchase_application_rls.root_cause: The application harness requires an authenticated restricted runtime credential that currently fails PostgreSQL authentication.
purchase_application_rls.resolution: Run a fresh authorized disposable initialization with a valid runtime credential, then execute the purchase workflow through the restricted role.
purchase_application_rls.acceptance: Same-tenant purchase operations and financial posting succeed; cross-tenant and missing/invalid tenant contexts fail closed; runtime role is NOSUPERUSER and NOBYPASSRLS.

q10_application_runtime.observed: Q10 fails reproducibly with PostgreSQL 28P01 for pharmnos_e2e_runtime.
q10_application_runtime.root_cause: The harness previously ignored FINANCIAL_E2E_RUNTIME_DB_PASSWORD; after correction, the disposable pre-existing runtime role still rejects the configured credential.
q10_application_runtime.correction: q10-application-path-validation.cjs now constructs bootstrap and runtime URLs from explicit credential variables.
q10_application_runtime.verification: The corrected harness reaches Prisma and still fails at runtime authentication, separating URL-source selection from role credential drift.
q10_application_runtime.remaining_action: Authorized disposable credential rotation or fresh ephemeral target provisioning; do not modify shared or production credentials.
q10_application_runtime.acceptance: Concurrent identical finalization has one effect set, replay returns the original result, conflicting payload is rejected, rollback leaves no effects, and retry succeeds.

direct_security_and_rollback.observed: Both scripts throw an explicit BLOCKED error before setup.
direct_security_and_rollback.root_cause: The scripts intentionally require the connected initialization adapter and currently have no run-bound authorization/evidence configuration.
direct_security_and_rollback.resolution: Supply a fresh authorized run/attempt binding and execute the existing guarded initialization sequence. Removing the early throws without that evidence would bypass the safety gate.
direct_security_and_rollback.acceptance: Connected initialization validates target, catalog, roles, RLS, runtime identity, and sanitized evidence before security/rollback execution.
